chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from 'Abdillah ibn Muskān, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him), knowing his right, Allah will register him among those in 'Illīyyīn.

key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: Illiyin, the highest ranks of Paradise where the records of the righteous are kept

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn with knowledge of his right?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh highlights the metaphysical elevation of visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn (a.s.) by linking it to the 'Illīyyīn, a term often associated with the highest celestial records in Quranic eschatology. This narration underscores the Shia doctrine that Ziyārah is not merely a physical act but a spiritual recognition (ma'rifa) of the Imam's divine right, thereby securing a place among the righteous elite in the hereafter.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥmmad ibn ‘Isā, from ‘Ali ibn Ḥakam, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Muskān, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Allāh will register those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights among those (who will be) in ‘Illīyyīn.
